census.title: 1 · Find your school
census.subtitle: Enter your school's census number. We'll fill in the details from the Ministry of Education school list.
census.label: Census number
census.hint: Usually 5 digits. The school office has it on MOE letters and the school census form.
census.empty: Enter the census number, or choose "My school isn't listed" below.
census.notListed: My school isn't listed / no census number
census.notListedHint: For private and international schools, or a school missing from the list. You fill in the details yourself and Sathiya reviews the school before it goes live.
census.lookupFailed: Could not look up the census number. Try again, or choose "My school isn't listed".
census.taken: This school is already registered. Ask the school admin for an invite link. Each school can register once.
census.report: Think someone registered it who shouldn't have? <report>Report a problem</report>

confirm.title: Is this your school?
confirm.subtitle: Census number {{census}} is in the Ministry of Education school list.
confirm.nameSiHint: Shown first on Sinhala timetables, print and the school list.
confirm.nameSiRequired: Enter the school name in Sinhala
confirm.nameEnHint: Official name from the MOE list.
confirm.districtHint: The MOE list doesn't give a district for this school.
confirm.gradesNote: {{span}} are created for you from the MOE grade span. Add classes and change grades later in Grade settings.
confirm.siNote: Sinhala names first. The school teaches in Sinhala, so forms ask for the Sinhala name of teachers and subjects first, then English. The app stays in English.
confirm.liveNote: Live straight away. Schools that match the MOE list don't need a Sathiya review. Publishing, invites and printing work from day one.
confirm.next: Yes, this is my school · Next: logo & colours

school.name: School name
school.nameHint: Fill both if you can. When one is empty, the other is shown on timetables, print and the school list.
school.title: 1 · School details
school.subtitle: You can edit these later in school profile.
school.gradesError: Lowest grade can't be above highest grade
school.censusHint: From the Ministry of Education school census. Each school can register once.
school.censusError: Census number must be 4 to 6 digits
school.noCensus: No census number (private / international schools only)
school.censusTaken: This school is already registered. Ask the school admin for an invite link. If you think the registration is fake, <report>report it</report>.
school.reviewTitle: Registering a school that isn't in the MOE school list.
school.reviewTitleCensus: Census number {{census}} isn't in the Ministry of Education school list.
school.reviewBody: You can still register. Sathiya reviews schools that aren't in the list before publishing, invites and printing are turned on. You can set everything up in the meantime.

brand.title: 2 · Logo & school colours
brand.subtitle: Your teachers will see these on every screen and on printed timetables.
brand.previewNote: Text colour is chosen automatically so it stays readable.

logo.hint: PNG or SVG, square, up to 1 MB
logo.typeError: Logo must be a PNG or SVG
logo.sizeError: Logo must be 1 MB or smaller

account.title: 3 · Your admin account
account.name: Your name
account.terms: I agree to the <terms>Terms & Conditions</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>, and I'm authorised to register this school.

signUp.title: Create account
signUp.terms: I agree to the <terms>Terms & Conditions</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

errors.emailInUse: That email already has an account. Log in instead.
errors.weakPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters
errors.generic: Could not register the school. Please try again.
errors.logoUpload: School created, but the logo could not be uploaded. Add it later in school profile.
errors.tooManySchools: This account already belongs to the most schools allowed (15).
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.termsOutdated: The Terms & Conditions have changed. Read the current terms, then tick the box again to accept them.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.body: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your email, then come back here to register your school.
verify.sendFailed: Could not send the email. Please try again shortly.
verify.firstSendFailed: Your account is ready, but we could not send the confirmation email. Use Send again to retry.
verify.notYet: Not verified yet. Open the link in the email, then try again.
verify.note: Signed in with Google? You skip this step.
verify.bodySignUp: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your email, then come back here to continue.
